prompt_headers: `high effort → 8 inline angles → dedup (no verify) → ≤10 findings`
commands: ls; ls ci; cat ci/test-complete; ls ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md 2>&1; grep -rn "rg.zsh\|complete-zsh\|complete/_rg\|_rg" --include=* -r . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=target -I | grep -v "^./crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh" | head -50

cat crates/core/flags/complete/zsh.rs && grep -n -B5 -A40 'complete-zsh' crates/core/flags/defs.rs | sed -n 1,90p && sed -n 370,385p crates/core/flags/doc/template.rg.1 && sed -n 1,30p CHANGELOG.md && zsh --version

W=/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs/2026-10-08-last-push-claude-opus/att-015/clone-work
C=/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs/2026-10-08-last-push-claude-opus/att-015/clone
mkdir -p $W/t $W/fp $W/fp2 && cd $W/t
sed 's/!ENCODINGS!/    utf-8 latin1/' $C/crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh > $W/fp/_rg
cp $W/fp/_rg $W/fp2/_ripgrep
cp $W/fp/_rg $W/t/_rg
echo "=== 1: source before compinit (no compdef)"
zsh -f -c "source <(cat $W/fp/_rg); echo rc=\$?; echo defined=\$+functions[_rg]" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "=== 2: source after compinit"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; source <(cat $W/fp/_rg); echo rc=\$?; echo \$_comps[rg]" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "=== 3: source by bare name _rg in cwd after compinit"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; source _rg; echo rc=\$?; echo comps=\$_comps[rg]" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "=== 3b: source ./_rg"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; source ./_rg; echo rc=\$?; echo comps=\$_comps[rg]" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "=== 4: ksh_arrays"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; setopt ksh_arrays; source <(cat $W/fp/_rg); echo rc=\$?; echo comps=\${_comps[rg]}" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "=== 5: test-complete style"
zsh -f -c "emulate zsh -o extended_glob -o no_function_argzero -o no_unset; f() { setopt local_options unset; ( _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source \$1 ) }; f $W/fp/_rg | wc -l" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== 6: eval"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; eval \"\$(cat $W/fp/_rg)\"; echo rc=\$?; echo comps=\$_comps[rg]" 2>&1 | head -5
echo "=== 7: source inside function named _rg? and wrapper"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; loadit() { source $W/fp/_rg }; loadit; echo rc=\$?; echo comps=\$_comps[rg]" 2>&1 | head -5

W=/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs/2026-10-08-last-push-claude-opus/att-015/clone-work
cd $W/t
echo "=== A: autoload under other name with compdef defined"
zsh -f -c "fpath=($W/fp2 \$fpath); compdef() { print -r -- \"compdef called: \$*\" }; _arguments() { print ARGS-CALLED }; autoload -U _ripgrep; _ripgrep; echo rc=\$?; echo second; _ripgrep; echo rc=\$?" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== B: autoload as _rg with compdef defined"
zsh -f -c "fpath=($W/fp \$fpath); compdef() { print -r -- \"compdef called: \$*\" }; _arguments() { print ARGS-CALLED }; autoload -U _rg; _rg; echo rc=\$?" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== C: ksh_autoload as _rg"
zsh -f -c "fpath=($W/fp \$fpath); setopt ksh_autoload; compdef() { print -r -- \"compdef called: \$*\" }; _arguments() { print ARGS-CALLED }; autoload -U _rg; _rg; echo rc=\$?" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== D: wrapper function calling _rg"
zsh -f -c "fpath=($W/fp \$fpath); compdef() { print -r -- \"compdef called: \$*\" }; _arguments() { print ARGS-CALLED }; autoload -U _rg; _myrg() { _rg \"\$@\" }; _myrg; echo rc=\$?" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== E: which vendor _rg"; zsh -f -c 'print -l $^fpath/_rg(N)'
echo "=== F: global alias hazard when sourced"
zsh -f -i -c "compdef() { : }; alias -g ret='XX'; source $W/fp/_rg; echo rc=\$?; whence -f _rg | grep -n 'XX' | head -3" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== G: sourced twice / positional args forwarded"
zsh -f -c "set -- a b; source $W/fp/_rg; echo rc=\$?" 2>&1 | head -3
